note: The two sets are nearly identical: both report the same two facts (pitch sensitivity ∂P/∂θ = -25.52E+6 watt/rad at θ = 0º and θK = 6.302336º), each duplicated under two entity labels (Blade-Pitch Controller and Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch), and both drop the stated meaning of θK (the pitch angle at which pitch sensitivity has doubled) and the Region 3 / best-fit-line context. The only substantive difference is that Set A gives the unit as watt/rad (matching the figure) while Set B truncates it to the invalid 'watt/ra' (also embedding the θ = 0º condition inside the attribute). Since Set B contains one misread unit and Set A none, A is marginally more faithful, though the sets are otherwise equivalent.
